name: redacta
description: Keep patient identifiers out of AI agent context — pseudonymise clinical text at a local privacy boundary, restore it only on your terms.
long_description: Redacta is a stateful privacy boundary between clinical text and AI agents. The protect tool replaces patient identifiers and personal data (NHS numbers with Modulus-11 validation, names, dates of birth, MRNs, emails, phones, postcodes, plus general PII like URLs, IPs, payment cards and account numbers) with labelled tokens — and keeps the reversal mapping inside the local server process, so it never enters the model context. Restoration happens at the boundary: release_to_file writes re-identified output to a folder you choose and returns only a receipt, while check_output catches identifiers leaking back verbatim in model output. Sessions expire automatically. Includes a HIPAA Safe Harbor mode. All processing happens locally — no network calls, nothing transmitted.

release_dir.title: Release folder
release_dir.description: Folder where re-identified output may be written by release_to_file. Leave unset to keep restoration disabled.

tools.name: protect
tools.description: Redact patient identifiers and PII into labelled tokens; the reversal mapping stays inside the local server and is never returned. Gives back protected text, an opaque session ID, a report, and a self-check.

tools.name: release_to_file
tools.description: Restore identifiers into text from a protected session, writing the result to your configured release folder. Returns a receipt only — restored data never enters the conversation.

tools.name: check_output
tools.description: Scan model output for verbatim reappearance of a session's original values and re-tokenise anything found. Reports leaked categories, never the raw values.

tools.name: discard_session
tools.description: Delete a session's private mapping immediately instead of waiting for expiry.

tools.name: redact
tools.description: Legacy: redact text and return the token map to the caller (the map enters the conversation). Prefer protect. Modes: clinical, general, safeharbor.

tools.name: reinstate
tools.description: Legacy: reverse a redaction using a caller-held token map.

tools.name: self_check
tools.description: Re-scan redacted text for anything that still looks like an identifier.
